action_instruction: Checking whether each cart item is displayed as a cart line
intent: whether each item currently in the cart is displayed as a cart line on the cart page

action_params.condition: Each item currently in the cart is displayed as a cart line on the cart page.
action_params.query: whether each item currently in the cart is displayed as a cart line on the cart page
action_params.code_js: (() => { const lines = el(7).querySelectorAll('.cart-line'); const qtySum = [...lines].reduce((sum, line) => sum + Number((line.querySelector('.qty-value')?.textContent || '0').trim()), 0); const cartCount = Number((el(5).textContent.match(/\d+/) || ['0'])[0]); return lines.length > 0 && [...lines].every(line => line.querySelector('.remove-line') && line.querySelector('.qty-value')) && qtySum === cartCount; })()

assertion_tree.description: The cart page displays a cart line for each item currently in the cart.

sub_results.description: Each item currently in the cart is displayed as a cart line on the cart page.

assertion_tree.verification: Each item currently in the cart is displayed as a cart line on the cart page.
